projects.title: Show HN: OpenBenchmarks – Helping agents discover and pick the right SaaS APIs
projects.author: fenilsuchak
projects.summary: I'm Fenil, co-founder/CEO of OpenFunnel (YC F24), building this with my co-founder/CTO Aditya. We're launching OpenBenchmarks ( https://openbenchmarks.com ), open-source, reproducible benchmarks for SaaS APIs, starting with the category we know best: GTM APIs. ## Why we built this More and more B2B software evaluation will/already runs through reasoning models inside agentic workflows rather than through people. And buyers increasingly pick vendors that are API-first and ship MCPs, so they can wire them into internal workflows. Strong reasoning models are skeptical of marketing. When a genuinely neutral benchmark is available, they discount SEO and self-published benchmarks, and they lose trust the moment something looks like a marketing claim. The thing that survives that skepticism is an independent build-first benchmark the agent can reproduce itself and trust. Reproducible by default: every cell ships the literal HTTP request/response plus the judge prompt/response All benchmarks live at https://github.com/openbenchmarks-labs . We start with GTM APIs, with more on the way. ## On Benching ourselves We benched our own product (OpenFunnel) as a vendor in the lookalikes benchmark, on purpose. We increasingly saw buyers asking for benchmarks on sales calls and were also curious to see if agents also made decisions the same way. We wanted to see whether an agent could run the whole loop end to end: discover the benchmark while researching a user's query, weigh it as the deciding factor in picking a winner for that user's category, then sign up and auth through to the chosen vendor to complete the task. That last stretch needs live vendors with agent-auth wired up: us and a few others. We came out #1 on the current seed (89% vs 74%). Because it's open, we don't win everything: depending on seed and metric (precision@10/@50/@100), we win some and lose others. ## Dogfooding We dogfooded it and ran 200 incognito simulated buyer flows through Claude Code with live web search, from query to discovery to sign-up, and watched which sources the model fetched and which ones made it into the final decision. The benchmark got opened in a large majority of runs, across the range of queries an actual buyer would ask in Claude Code, from building a lookalikes workflow to picking a lookalike API provider. And when it was opened, it usually drove the final call, over self-published GEO pages and vendor benchmarks with years of domain authority. We've studied the effect and potential ROI of being benched, we're taking OpenFunnel off the benchmark. ## What's next More GTM benchmarks, then beyond: devtools and infrastructure. We're are also working with traditional SaaS companies thinking about going API-first and opening up to a new class of customer: agents Try it, or hand it to your agent: https://openbenchmarks.com

projects.title: 【工具自荐】VeryCapture 2.0发布： 5 年前做的的截图工具，这次大版本升级了什么？
projects.author: acjog
projects.summary: 图注：VeryCapture 2.0 正式发布 — 5 年 · 2.5 万+ 用户（2026 上半年）· 基础版免费 2021 年初，VeryCapture 从一个很小的念头开始：不想登录聊天工具去截图，不想读外文时反复切换翻译。我们把截图、长截图、OCR、翻译、录屏整合到一起——只为一种体验：留在手头的事里，不被打断。 五年迭代，2.5 万+ 用户验证（2026 上半年数据），VeryCapture 2.0 正式发布。 共鸣：这些场景，你可能也遇到过 开发 / 运营：给同事报 Bug，先截图，再打开标注工具画箭头，又要录一段 GIF 说明点击位置——三步操作，上下文早忘了。 学生 / 跨境办公：浏览外文资料，选中一段想翻译，复制、切换、粘贴、再切回来；遇到图片里的文字，普通 OCR 往往只认中英文——法语、日语截图里的内容，还得另找工具。 教师 / 博主 / 上班族：网页太长、聊天记录太多，普通截图截不全；截完想贴屏对照写文档，又得找别的工具。 它们的共同点不是「缺一个截图功能」，而是：一件小事，被登录、切换、等待拖成一连串打断。 你本来在处理 A，工具却强行把你拽到 B。 如果上面有一条说中了你的日常——VeryCapture 最初就是为此做的，2.0.8 则是把这条路线走得更加完整。 解法：一条链路，留在当前工作里 VeryCapture 2.0 想解决的核心问题很简单：屏幕上的信息，从「看到」到「截下来、改清楚、发出去、抄下来」，尽量不离开手头的事。 所以它不是「又一个截图软件」，而是一套连贯的工作流： 截图 — 矩形、任意形状、延时、全屏；截完直接标注，箭头、文字、马赛克、取色，不用另开编辑器 图注：截完即改 — 标注是截图的一部分，不是事后补丁 长截图 — 网页、文档、聊天记录，滚动内容一次截全 图注：竖直长截图 — 滚动内容一次截全 图注：【更新 1】水平长截图 — 宽表格一次截全，2.0.8 新增 OCR + 翻译 — 覆盖 中文（简体）、日文，以及 50 种拉丁语系文字（英语、法语、德语、西班牙语、葡萄牙语、意大利语、俄语等）；图片文字截图即提取、复制、翻译，读外文不必来回切窗口 图注：东亚文字：简中 / 日文，截图即识 GIF / 视频录制 — 教程、演示、Bug 反馈，支持鼠标点击效果，观众看得懂你在点哪里 贴图 — 截图钉在屏幕上，写文档、对代码时当参考层 绿色免安装，解压即用；官方渠道不捆绑任何第三方软件；基础版免费、无广告，日常办公开箱即用；重度用户可按需升级专业版。 一句话：按一下快捷键，留在你正在做的事里——这就是「不被打扰」。 证据：5 年积累，2.0 焕新 时间本身就是证据。 2021 年上线至今，VeryCapture 持续迭代 5 年+——不是蹭热度的新工具，而是被长期使用、反复验证过的成熟方案。仅 2026 上半年，活跃用户已达 2.5 万+、累计事件 327 万次。 图注：2026 上半年（1 月至今）数据口径——活跃用户 2.5 万+，环比增长 20% 2.0 这次具体升级了什么？ 【更新 1】 长截图支持竖直方向和水平方向拼接，拼接算法更智能 【更新 2】 OCR 升级：50 种拉丁语系 + 中/日，外文截图识别更稳 【更新 3】 录屏功能升级，画中画，系统声音和麦克风混音 【更新 4】 稳定性修复与 UI 细节打磨 几个被老用户反复提到的能力： OCR 双体系覆盖 —— 东亚文字：简中、日文；拉丁语系：50 种（英法德西葡意俄等）。一张截图，不只认英文，跨境阅读、论文资料不用找在线 OCR 截完即改 —— 诞生之初就是因为现有工具二次编辑体验差；标注是截图的一部分，不是事后补丁 录 GIF 带点击效果 —— 讲清楚一个操作，比十张静态图省事 便携、不捆绑 —— 公司电脑、临时环境，U 盘带走就能用 一体化截图工具今天已经不少，说明需求是真实的。VeryCapture 属于较早做这一类集成的那一批——选它的理由，是 5 年成熟度和 2.0 大升级，而不是谁功能清单更长。

projects.title: Show HN: An agentic CRM, built for AI agents to drive over plain HTTP
projects.author: _pdp_
projects.summary: Hi HN, Earlier this year we decided to replace a number of our internal systems with agent-first alternatives. We couldn't find anything that worked well as a CRM. After several unsuccessful attempts to model the problem with markdown files and SQLite databases, we realised there was more to it than putting an agent on top of a database. We didn't want to build another dashboard, pipeline view, or data-entry tool. Instead, we wanted the CRM to be something agents can operate directly to create leads, update deals, summarise accounts, track follow-ups, and generally help run the business without forcing humans to spend their day maintaining records. The CRM is live and we use it internally. It is open source, hackable, and designed with swappable backends, so it can run locally, on Cloudflare, Fly, AWS, or wherever you prefer. Our own use cases are still limited, but if the project interests you, contributions are very welcome. The goal is to rethink CRMs from the ground up, and in the process figure out what it means to build software for a different kind of user, one that does not want, or need, another data-entry application. Feedback is more than welcome, and thank you for your time.

The first duel doesn't require any sign-up and is extremely simple to use! Further i created the main platform AskPitch out of a true pain point that i had come across in which i had to pitch to clients over a sales call, give presentations, talk in public, handle objections in a way where i had to speak in the correct tone with confidence and know what to say while handling objections with ease. AskPitch allows its users to practice in a practice room to optimize their delivery, tone and confidence as well as a Live Roleplay area where users can have 1-1 conversations with a number of characters available for them to choose from where they can further better their pitches. There are a lot of areas in which a person needs to be good at while pitching. I had all the issues mentioned above and did not know what to say under pressure or when face to face with a prospect, and imagine the horror when i had to speak in front of a crowd. This is where AskPitch was born, I created it to help me with my pitches, my delivery, my tone, my confidence and soon i noticed i started getting positive feedback from the people i was speaking to, i noticed the butterflies in my stomach were noticeably fading over time, i noticed that i was smiling more often when meeting with clients, whether face to face or through a call and soon enough, i saw myself becoming good and becoming better like i was being optimized. I knew i found something and realized that there are many others just like me who have the same issue as i previously did and this could most definitely help them in a very positive and progressive way and so i started building AskPitch for people to practice and use while they're out and about or while they're at home or right before a pitch or even right before an interview! AskPitch allows its users to practice from a variety of scenarios such as: Insurance call opening Busy Prospect Objection Difficult client conversation Explain your business Job Interviews Investor Pitches Presentation Warmups Stage Talks Thank you and i hope you find this as useful as i did.

LLM in a side tab doesn't work, you can't always type and listen at the same time... and it knows nothing about your call anyway. Then I built the better version, an AI commenting on the call live. projects.title: Show HN: Nectar, a Rust-like React that compiles to WebAssembly
projects.author: blakeburnette
projects.summary: After a pretty rough gig experience, I wanted to remind myself that I was a vaguely capable developer. I had recently jumped on the Rust train and wanted a Rust equivalent of React that is more performant and easier to work with. I also wondered if I could effectively eject Javascript. This project came from that... Nectar is a programming language that compiles your entire app, logic, state, and rendering, to WebAssembly. JavaScript is reduced to a roughly 10 KB syscall layer that only bridges WASM to the DOM. The origin: I set out to get React-style ergonomics with better performance, and about halfway in I realized I had hit the ceiling of what was possible going through the browser's DOM (Blink/C++) and a diffing step. So I stopped fighting it and built my own signal-driven rendering layer that compiles to WASM and updates exactly the DOM nodes that changed, in O(1), with no virtual DOM and no garbage collector. What it is right now: - One binary. The same compiler does formatting, linting, testing, a dev server, an LSP, and SSR (although SSR is underdeveloped). - Fine-grained signals. Each binding updates on its own, so there is no diffing pass. - A Rust-inspired borrow checker for compile-time safety. - Language-level keywords for the patterns you reach for constantly on the web: component, store, router, form, auth, payment. - SEO and Screen Readers. It compiles to two DOMs from the same source so the app stays visible to screen readers and crawlers. Honest status, because this is early and it is mostly one person: - The "no JavaScript" line has an asterisk. WASM cannot touch the DOM directly, so there is a small JS bridge (about 10 KB) that as of this moment I cannot overcome on major browsers. - The numbers on the site (a counter is ~10 KB versus ~387 KB for React plus JS) are real but small examples, not a full-app shootout. projects.title: 【创业日记】创业三个月，我进入了创业的倦怠期
projects.author: yanghan-pp
projects.summary: 开始创业前，看多了各种创业几个月就融了几千万，一个爆款视频涨了几万用户的鸡汤文，总对创业怀着不一样的憧憬和雄心壮志。 我们的产品的产品叫“连连AI”，用AI帮你找人和自动沟通，适合程序员、创业者等群体之间进行连接。但也正是因为平台性产品的定位，我们需要很多很多的用户。 但我显然低估了从0到1的漫长，也低估了从0到1的困难程度。 因为你的生活大概率不是营销爽文。 爽文有多爽，现实就有多残酷。 爽文告诉你，靠一个什么东西就实现了用户疯狂的增长，实现了融资过亿的爽局。它掩饰了所有的泥泞，仿佛所有东西都轻而易举，但你很快会被现实狠狠打脸。 你开始尝试各种渠道，各种方式，发现好像并没有一个特别好的反馈和结果。 你以为是因为自己不够努力，于是加倍地、不敢休息地、没日没夜地狠狠地干。但数据依然在那里，令人尴尬的数据，涨不起来，要死不活。 于是你开始怀疑、倦怠，失去方向，失去最开始的冲劲和激情，现实比你想象中还要残酷。 有时候你根本都不知道问题出在了哪里，你甚至都不知道自己是哪里做错了。 创业如何克服倦怠期？我不知道，或许因为我现在本来就深陷其中。 或许有一天我知道了解决的方法，会再来与大家分享，又或者一直难以解决，直到失败。 但是又是否后悔呢我？我不知道，应该是不后悔的吧，因为我觉得是正确的事情。并且，我始终会把创业排在我的人生清单的第一或者第二位。 只是告诉所有想要创业的朋友，创业确实是一次心理的煎熬，你需要足够的热爱带你渡过这一切。 加油吧！与君共勉！

projects.title: Show HN: Open-source sandbox for your product team
projects.author: spacspade
projects.summary: Kshitij and Rahul here. We're building Playground, an open-source sandbox that lets your non-technical teams prototype directly on production codebases, without bugging you (developers) to spin up and maintain another repo. The repo is here: https://github.com/B1u3B01t/design-playground . We've been working together for six years. Last year we built an AI design agent because we thought designers were the biggest bottleneck. But we were wrong. After talking to teams, we realised designers, PMs, founders and even sales people all wanted to quickly change and explore flows for their users, that looked and behaved like the real app. But devs don't trust non-technical teams to work on production and not fuck up the code. Agree. So the other way is setting up another mock repo. And that defeats the point. It adds maintenance cost of keeping both in sync. This is what happened when both of us were working together too. So we built an open-source Playground. It has all the features out of the box: super intuitive, good ux, links to claude/codex, latest features, easy additions of skills, collaborative and best of all, safe guardrails so if you want, you can get the code in one click (unlike figma or other closed source shit). I work on the Playground. Rahul on Conductor. We're super claude pilled and believe in this duo being the new product team size, something coinbase and square are already doing with "pods". Right now it supports Nextjs projects. We will definitely add more frameworks and improve the developer experience. We'd especially love feedback from teams already maintaining internal sandboxes. Go let your non-tech team play.

projects.summary: QRForge 是一个面向打印工作流的二维码生成器。 它跟常见的在线二维码工具不太一样，重点不是跳转统计或营销追踪，而是生成可以长期使用的静态直连二维码，适合产品标签、活动胸牌、包装插卡、菜单等打印场景。 主要功能： 无需登录即可生成静态 URL 二维码 支持 CSV 批量生成二维码 生成前可以预览前几行数据，减少打印错误 导出 PNG / SVG 文件 批量项目会生成 manifest、错误报告、PDF 摘要和 ZIP 包 静态二维码不依赖平台跳转服务，打印后不会因为平台关闭而失效 我做这个工具的原因是，很多二维码平台默认把链接变成自己的跳转地址，适合统计，但对于已经印刷出去的二维码来说，多了一层长期依赖。QRForge 更偏向“生成后可独立存在”的打印文件工作流。 技术栈：Next.js、React、Cloudflare Workers、Stripe Checkout。 希望对需要批量制作二维码标签、胸牌、包装二维码的人有帮助。

projects.title: Show HN: Morning Report – daily briefing compiled from Sentry, Linear, Gmail,etc
projects.author: bchhabra2490
projects.summary: Hi HN, I built Morning Report because every morning I was losing the first 30 minutes just checking Sentry, Linear, Gmail, and PostHog separately before doing any real work. It connects to the tools you already use and compiles a single daily briefing, organized into five sections: what broke overnight, what you committed to, what's performing, what needs you, and what happened in the world. Delivered by email and archived on a dashboard. The part I spent the most time on: instead of a generic AI summary, you set your own "editorial voice" in plain English for how you want your data filtered and prioritized. Something like "only show Sentry errors affecting 3+ users" or "always lead with revenue." It actually follows it every morning. Stack: Next.js, Supabase, Inngest for the scheduled collection jobs, Claude for synthesis. 28 integrations across mail, dev tools, payments, analytics, CRM, and calendar (Gmail, GitHub, GitLab, Bitbucket, Linear, Jira, Notion, Trello, Stripe, Razorpay, PostHog, Mixpanel, Sentry, Datadog, HubSpot, and more — a few marked "soon" as I roll them out). Free tier connects 2 tools. Pro is $5/month for everything. Would love feedback, especially on what other integrations would be useful and whether the "editorial voice" idea lands or feels like overkill.

projects.title: Show HN: Clockjumper – An Intervibed Project
projects.author: HaphazardGuess
projects.summary: Hello there, Long time listener, first time caller over here. I’ve been meaning to try A.I coding capabilities for some time now. I wanted to focus on a problem that is simple enough for me to execute all the way to the finish line. I didn’t want to mess with any backend complexities or deal with a website that requires APIs or some such. I figured a simple timezone conversion tool would be a decent choice. It is a solved problem to the point of becoming a commodity and all I’m doing is adding, subtracting time and making some tweaks here and there. I don’t know if someone out there has already coined a term for this workflow of mine but I’m claiming a stake and naming it “an Intervibed project”. I’ve used multiple different A.Is to code everything and I can assure you that I’m actively suffering from “Prompt Fatigue”…….so what about this one? has this term been coined yet? I damn sure hope so! The project is being hosted on Lovable, I run my initial prompts thru chatgpt 5.5 Pro and then submit the results to Claude Opus 4.8 Max and then I submit the final execution order to Lovable. I initially used Lovable’s own design capabilities to do the UX/UI but when Claude released the design feature I ran the whole through that and I’m using a new design now. As for SEO/GEO, I created this project six months ago and at that time the Lovable websites were not getting crawled by search engines. After the recent Lovable update, they have pretty much solved that issue (or so I’ve been told?). I recreated the project on the new tech stack and I have no issues with Google Search Console crawling and indexing. I’m also promoting this website on Facebook and once again I’m using a similar workflow to create….or rather generate posts for socials….I’m very curious to see how and when will the artwork start to drift. I have locked down a “master spec” for every asset but still every time I generate something new from my existing assets it looks a bit off. It’s definitely been quite an experience and I’ve learned a ton about how these A.I products approach a problem, their limitations, strengths. All of this can become a write up on its own in the future and It’s a gonna be a one long rant guaranteed. I feel like I can make some unbelievably basic UX/UI and productivity recommendations to the product managers in charge of these multizillion dollar companies. A.I is supposed to save us time and effort and it sure does, but the actual mechanics of using the A.I tools is still residing in the stoneage…is “A.I Stoneage” a term yet? It should be. I will give you one example, why am I not able to collapse specific prompts responses inside a chat? Why am I not allowed to delete a specific response within a long chat? This is simple stuff folks, forums were doing these things back when dinosaurs roamed the earth….I remember very clearly….anyways. I would like for you all to take this lil’ website of mine for a test drive and tell me what do you think. Your positive feedback will encourage me to keep on going and the negative’s ones will help me do a better job. Boy oh boy I do want to be doing a better job. Keep in my mind that this is just a fun side project that I spend 2,3 hours a week on and it’s all been done in good fun! Thanks much, P
